label: Field Optics
description: Lens choices for machine photography in the field — long glass carries the 'reach' tag, character glass carries 'retro'.

items.name: 600mm-f4
items.text: shot on a 600mm f/4 super-telephoto, distance stacked flat, heat shimmer between lens and subject rendered honestly

items.name: 400mm-f28
items.text: shot on a 400mm f/2.8, the subject isolated clean against melted background color, the professional sideline standard

items.name: 70-200-zoom
items.text: shot on a 70-200mm f/2.8 workhorse zoom, framing ridden tight as the subject moves through the scene

items.name: 500mm-mirror
items.text: shot on a 500mm catadioptric mirror lens, flat stacked planes and bright-ringed donut bokeh, a proud retro signature

items.name: 135mm-prime
items.text: shot on a 135mm f/2 prime, classic three-quarter compression pulling the setting close in behind the subject

items.name: 85mm-detail
items.text: shot on an 85mm prime stopped to f/4, honest mid-telephoto drawing for tight sections and hardware detail

items.name: 50mm-document
items.text: shot on a 50mm at f/5.6, documentary neutrality, proportions rendered exactly as the eye reads them

items.name: 35mm-reportage
items.text: shot on a 35mm f/1.4, reportage framing that keeps the machine in its world, foreground life allowed into the edges

items.name: 24mm-proximity
items.text: shot on a 24mm from arm's length, near surfaces stretched dramatic while the setting sweeps away to the vanishing point

items.name: vintage-uncoated
items.text: shot on an uncoated vintage prime, gentle veiling flare, swirling edges and highlights that bloom like memory
